coordinate_frame: Every frame is unwrapped and least-squares aligned to the starting receptor CA atoms before classification.
homologous_superpocket: Accepted METTL7B FPOCKET pocket 2 (1690.538 A3, 197 alpha spheres), rigidly CA-transferred to METTL7A.

metrics.superpocket_fraction: fraction of ligand heavy atoms within 4.0 A of any homologous-superpocket alpha sphere
metrics.productive_TSL_envelope_fraction: fraction of ligand heavy atoms within 1.7 A of the union of the pre-existing productive TSL states
metrics.mouth_projection_A: ligand centroid displacement projected from the sphere centroid toward its most peripheral sphere

event_persistence.rule: A transition is recorded only after the new raw state persists for five consecutive saved frames; boundary flickers are relabeled to the preceding persistent state.

recapture: A persistent MOUTH or ESCAPE state followed by persistent INNER; OUTSIDE-to-INNER is separately labeled REENTRY_FROM_OUTSIDE.
irreversible_escape_within_window: Final persistent state is ESCAPE or OUTSIDE and remains so through the final saved frame.
